# Accelerance Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (Accelerance Tech)
> Award-Winning Digital Growth, Web Engineering, Headless eCommerce & Autonomous AI Agency

Accelerance Tech (legal entity: Accelerance Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) is an international digital engineering and growth agency founded in 2018. We specialize in high-velocity Next.js web applications, headless Shopify storefronts, Flutter cross-platform mobile apps, autonomous AI agents, HubSpot RevOps, and data-driven performance marketing.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Website Design & Custom Web Development**: Enterprise Next.js, React, Node.js platforms engineered for sub-second performance, zero layout shift, and SEO dominance. URL: https://accelerance.tech/services/web-design-development/
- **Headless Shopify & eCommerce Solutions**: Custom Shopify storefronts, sub-second search filtering, one-page mobile checkouts, and multi-channel inventory bridges. URL: https://accelerance.tech/services/headless-shopify-ecommerce/
- **Mobile Application Development (iOS & Android)**: Production Flutter and React Native apps with offline synchronization and biometric auth. URL: https://accelerance.tech/services/mobile-app-development-flutter/
- **Autonomous AI Agents & Chatbots**: Generative AI workflows, private LLM deployments, RAG knowledge bases, and customer support automations. URL: https://accelerance.tech/services/ai-agents-chatbots/
- **HubSpot CRM, RevOps & Marketing Automation**: Multi-touch attribution, sales pipeline synchronization, lifecycle lead nurturing, and custom API bridges. URL: https://accelerance.tech/services/hubspot-revops-crm/
- **Full Capabilities Matrix**: https://accelerance.tech/services/
